scripts.shadow:watch:hoop-ui: npx shadow-cljs watch hoop-ui browser-test karma-test
scripts._comment:dev: postcss:build runs ONCE, serially, and postcss:watch is deliberately not in the parallel group. run-p spawns children with stdio[0]='ignore' (npm-run-all lib/run-task.js detectStreamKind returns 'ignore' for a null stream, and its CLI has no way to pass stdin), and postcss-cli exits on stdin end (postcss-cli/index.js: process.stdin.on('end', () => process.exit(0))). So the watcher died on startup with code 0 and no message, run-p reported success, and resources/public/css/ — which is gitignored in full — was never created: every ClojureScript route rendered unstyled until some other command happened to build the file. Run postcss:watch directly in a second terminal if you are editing Tailwind classes in .cljs; it works there, because a terminal gives it a real stdin.
scripts.dev:hoop-ui: { [ -f .env ] && set -a && . ./.env && set +a; true; } && npm run postcss:build && run-p -l genversion shadow:watch:hoop-ui
